issue: Subject 3 scores about 0.88 macro-F1 with every model
evidence: LOSO, held-out subject 3: Extra Trees 0.889, Logistic 0.884, XGBoost 0.881; all 298 sitting windows predicted as standing (Extra Trees, XGBoost) or split between standing 144 and knee_bend 154 (Logistic); the other 11 activities are almost perfect
cause: Posture, not the model: while sitting, subject 3 kept the wrist hanging (wrist acc x,y,z mean = 0.5, -9.6, 1.5), the same as the standing pattern of all people (about -2.5, -9.3, 1.2), while the other 9 people rested the forearm (wrist acc x between -1.6 and -8.9); chest and ankle look the same in sitting and standing because there is no thigh sensor
consequence: One whole class is lost for one person, macro-F1 drops by about 1/12
action: Report as a limitation; a thigh or hip sensor, or more people, would be needed to separate sitting from standing

evidence: LOSO, held-out subject 6: Extra Trees 0.873 (jogging to running 298, running to jogging 99), Logistic 0.889 (jogging to running 298), XGBoost 0.942 (jogging to running 182)
cause: Subject 6 jogs harder than the others: wrist motion while jogging 8.41 against 7.39 for the other people jogging and 6.77 for the other people running; jogging and running differ only in speed, and speed is relative to each person
consequence: Jogging and running are confused for this person
action: Report as person shift; per-person calibration or merging jogging and running would remove it

issue: Expected result "boosted trees lead" is not confirmed
evidence: LOSO mean macro-F1: Extra Trees 0.962, XGBoost 0.958, Logistic 0.955, HistGB 0.951, Random Forest 0.950, LightGBM 0.933 (7th of 10); paired Wilcoxon Extra Trees vs XGBoost p = 0.945; sd between people about 0.05
cause: Activities in MHEALTH are well separated by simple window statistics, so model choice matters less than differences between people; only 10 people, so differences below about 0.03 cannot be resolved
consequence: No single best model can be claimed
action: Write that the top five models are equivalent; no tuning was done (hyperparameters fixed as in the proposal)

issue: ROAR does not separate the explanation methods
evidence: Removing the top 10 features and retraining (3 seeds): TreeSHAP 0.932, KernelSHAP 0.912, LIME 0.933, Permutation 0.907, Gain 0.948, Random 0.950, all features 0.947; Gain is non-monotonic (k=6 0.939, k=10 0.948)
cause: Features are redundant (mean and SD of axes and magnitude of the same sensor, and other positions), so the retrained model recovers the information from the remaining features
consequence: Only the gap between masking (0.31 to 0.54) and retraining (0.91 to 0.95) is a firm result; the ranking between methods is not
action: Report the masking vs retraining gap as the main RQ3 finding; removing whole groups of correlated features would be a stronger test

issue: Feature rankings change between two disjoint sets of people
evidence: Spearman rank correlation between models trained on people {1,2,3} and {4,5,6,7}: Gain 0.61, KernelSHAP 0.56, TreeSHAP 0.52, LIME 0.46, Permutation 0.30
cause: Each training group has only 3 or 4 people, and posture differs between people (see D1)
consequence: Feature-level explanations should not be read as stable; body-position shares are more stable than single features
action: Interpret explanations at the body-position level

issue: A single body position is not safe for every person
evidence: LOSO LightGBM: only ankle 0.792 (worst person 0.559), only chest 0.786 (0.631), only wrist 0.749 (0.533); drop chest device 0.894 (0.809); all positions 0.934 (0.867)
cause: Each position sees only part of the body movement; person differences add up when only one position is used
consequence: Mean scores keep 80 to 85 percent of the full macro-F1 but the worst person loses almost half of the activities
action: Recommend ankle plus wrist and dropping the chest device

issue: The ECG feature does not measure heart rate
evidence: ecg_lead1_std rises from 0.34 to 0.39 at rest to 1.12 in running; ECG-only model 0.118 macro-F1; adding ECG to chest acceleration 0.786 to 0.782; attribution share of ECG 0.001 to 0.049
cause: The feature is the SD of raw ECG voltage in a 2 s window, which grows with motion artefacts; heart rate would need R-peak detection
consequence: Claims about heart activity are not supported
action: Describe it as ECG signal variability; add a heart-rate feature if heart activity is a research question
